verdict.rationale: MX documents a dedicated test platform with four test institutions and an OpenAPI spec importable into Postman, plus guidance on testing the Connect Widget's OAuth flow end-to-end — directly supporting sandbox-based linking/testing before production use. However, the evidence does not show explicit documented test credentials for each test institution or guidance on simulating specific error states. Missing for 10: documented test credentials per institution, explicit error-state/failure simulation guidance.
